assessment.message: P7, “相同的优化结果” needs a precise meaning before Astra7 can check it. Show a short English parenting prompt using two explicitly hypothetical runs with equal final loss but different final weights. Ask your child to write one sentence comparing the losses and one comparing the weights, citing the supplied values. Put the actual values and prompt here now. Keep activation functions out of this exercise so the comparison stays focused; assess Astra7’s returned sentences rather than treating its network-conditions question as a completed test.
